I have an account and tell people I just stopped using it years ago, which I did.
I always turn down new friend requests and explain I use it only for family and very close friends, so no to my realtor, tax guy, neighbors, people I went to high school with, etc.

And nothing of value was lost.

Seriously, what could possibly be so important on her FB account that a legal name change would even be considered? I can't imagine it was making her tons of money or anything so this is just a stupid move on her part. But of course, there's probably more here than at first seems. This is probably some PR stunt/hoax that is meant to go viral and she'll cash in on her 15 minutes of Internet fame. Move along people. Nothing to see here.

I know a lot of people who use Facebook to create digital photo albums, and oftentimes people will lock-down the privacy on them. I have several private albums, and if I was locked out of my account, there would be absolutely no way to recover them. Most of them, I wouldn't care too much about, and a few of them I would. But some people use Facebook to document everything they do, and I think that is the case with this woman.
